public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.Ring
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.Involution
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Star.Module

/-!
# The original Haar twisted convolution star ring

The star law follows on the original coefficient functions by commuting the
actual action-composed adjoint map with their Bochner integral and then making
the literal left-Haar substitution `t ↦ s * t`. The character remains the
right-pushforward modular character and the involution factor remains `δ(s)`.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory Filter
open scoped CompactlySupported CStarAlgebra

namespace HaarTwistedCore

noncomputable section

universe uG uA

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular] (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- The original modular involution reverses the literal left-Haar twisted convolution. -/
theorem crossedStar_convolution (f g : Carrier μ α) :
    crossedStar μ α (convolution μ α f g) =
      convolution μ α (crossedStar μ α g) (crossedStar μ α f) := by
  apply ext μ α
  intro s
  let : NormedSpace ℝ A := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ A
  let d : G → ℂ := fun r => ((Measure.modularCharacter r : ℝ) : ℂ)
  let S : A →L⋆[ℂ] A := ⟨(starLinearEquiv ℂ).toLinearMap, continuous_star⟩
  let T : A →L[ℂ] A :=
    ⟨LinearMap.ofClass (α.aut s), (StarAlgEquiv.isometry (α.aut s)).continuous⟩
  let J : A →L⋆[ℂ] A := T.comp S
  have hJ (a : A) : J a = α s (star a) := rfl
  have hδ (t : G) : d (s * t) * d t⁻¹ = d s := by
    have h : Measure.modularCharacter (s * t) * Measure.modularCharacter t⁻¹ =
        Measure.modularCharacter s := by
      rw [← map_mul, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel, mul_one]
    have hreal : (Measure.modularCharacter (s * t) : ℝ) *
        (Measure.modularCharacter t⁻¹ : ℝ) = (Measure.modularCharacter s : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast h
    change ((Measure.modularCharacter (s * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      ((Measure.modularCharacter t⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) = ((Measure.modularCharacter s : ℝ) : ℂ)
    exact_mod_cast hreal
  have hPoint (t : G) :
      kernel α (toCc μ α (crossedStar μ α g)) (toCc μ α (crossedStar μ α f)) s (s * t) =
        d s • J (kernel α (toCc μ α f) (toCc μ α g) s⁻¹ t) := by
    have hq : (s * t)⁻¹ * s = t⁻¹ := by
      rw [mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel, mul_one]
    have hJkernel : J (kernel α (toCc μ α f) (toCc μ α g) s⁻¹ t) =
        α (s * t) (star (g (s * t)⁻¹)) * α s (star (f t)) := by
      rw [hJ, kernel]
      rw [star_mul, ← PointNormCStarAction.apply_star, PointNormCStarAction.apply_mul_elem,
        ← PointNormCStarAction.apply_mul, mul_inv_rev]
    rw [hJkernel]
    change crossedStar μ α g (s * t) * α (s * t) (crossedStar μ α f ((s * t)⁻¹ * s)) =
      d s • (α (s * t) (star (g (s * t)⁻¹)) * α s (star (f t)))
    rw [crossedStar_apply, crossedStar_apply, hq, inv_inv, PointNormCStarAction.apply_smul]
    change (d (s * t) • α (s * t) (star (g (s * t)⁻¹))) *
      (d t⁻¹ • α (s * t) (α t⁻¹ (star (f t)))) =
        d s • (α (s * t) (star (g (s * t)⁻¹)) * α s (star (f t)))
    have hα : α (s * t) (α t⁻¹ (star (f t))) = α s (star (f t)) := by
      rw [← PointNormCStarAction.apply_mul, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel, mul_one]
    rw [hα, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_smul, hδ]
  have hJIntegral :
      (∫ t, J (kernel α (toCc μ α f) (toCc μ α g) s⁻¹ t) ∂μ) =
        J (∫ t, kernel α (toCc μ α f) (toCc μ α g) s⁻¹ t ∂μ) :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.integral_comp_commSL (by intro r z; simp) J
      (integrable_kernel μ α (toCc μ α f) (toCc μ α g) s⁻¹)
  calc
    crossedStar μ α (convolution μ α f g) s =
        d s • J (∫ t, kernel α (toCc μ α f) (toCc μ α g) s⁻¹ t ∂μ) := by
      simp only [crossedStar_apply, convolution_apply, hJ, d, kernel]
    _ = d s • ∫ t, J (kernel α (toCc μ α f) (toCc μ α g) s⁻¹ t) ∂μ :=
      congrArg (fun a : A => d s • a) hJIntegral.symm
    _ = ∫ t, d s • J (kernel α (toCc μ α f) (toCc μ α g) s⁻¹ t) ∂μ :=
      (integral_smul _ _).symm
    _ = ∫ t, kernel α (toCc μ α (crossedStar μ α g))
        (toCc μ α (crossedStar μ α f)) s (s * t) ∂μ :=
      integral_congr_ae (Eventually.of_forall fun t => (hPoint t).symm)
    _ = ∫ r, kernel α (toCc μ α (crossedStar μ α g))
        (toCc μ α (crossedStar μ α f)) s r ∂μ := by
      have he : MeasurableEmbedding (fun t : G => s * t) :=
        (Homeomorph.mulLeft s).measurableEmbedding
      rw [← he.integral_map, map_mul_left_eq_self]
    _ = convolution μ α (crossedStar μ α g) (crossedStar μ α f) s := by
      simp only [convolution_apply, kernel]

/-- The original convolution ring has the original modularly twisted source star. -/
instance instStarRingCarrier : StarRing (Carrier μ α) where
  star_mul := crossedStar_convolution μ α
  star_add := crossedStar_add μ α

end

end HaarTwistedCore

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.StarRing
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.IntegratedOperator
public import MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.Group.HaarWeightedInversion

/-!
# Haar-integrated covariant star-algebra homomorphisms

The original compact-support convolution core acts by its actual vector-integrated
operators. Compact-support vector Fubini and left translation prove multiplication;
the modularly weighted inversion formula and Hilbert adjoints prove star preservation.
The homomorphism retains the original vector action and literal coefficient L1 bound.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory Filter Set
open scoped CompactlySupported CStarAlgebra InnerProductSpace Pointwise

namespace CovariantRepresentation

noncomputable section

universe uG uA uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular]
variable {α : PointNormCStarAction G A} (ρ : CovariantRepresentation α H)

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [μ.Regular] in
/-- The original Haar convolution acts by the product of its actual integrated operators. -/
theorem haarIntegratedOperator_mul (f g : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :
    StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator μ ρ.group ρ.algebra
        (HaarTwistedCore.toCc μ α (f * g)) =
      StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator μ ρ.group ρ.algebra
          (HaarTwistedCore.toCc μ α f) *
        StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator μ ρ.group ρ.algebra
          (HaarTwistedCore.toCc μ α g) := by
  let : NormedSpace ℝ A := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ A
  let fc : C_c(G, A) := HaarTwistedCore.toCc μ α f
  let gc : C_c(G, A) := HaarTwistedCore.toCc μ α g
  let P : A →L[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H) :=
    ⟨{ toFun := ρ.algebra
       map_add' := map_add ρ.algebra
       map_smul' := fun c a => map_smul ρ.algebra c a }, map_continuous ρ.algebra⟩
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro ξ
  let K : G → G → H := fun s t =>
    ρ.algebra (HaarTwistedCore.kernel α fc gc s t) ((ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ)
  have hKcont : Continuous K.uncurry :=
    ((map_continuous ρ.algebra).comp
      (HaarTwistedCore.continuous_kernel α fc gc)).clm_apply
        ((ρ.group.continuous_orbit ξ).comp continuous_fst)
  let Sfg : Set G := tsupport fc * tsupport gc
  have hSfgcompact : IsCompact Sfg := fc.hasCompactSupport.mul gc.hasCompactSupport
  have hSfgclosed : IsClosed Sfg :=
    (isClosed_tsupport gc).mul_left_of_isCompact fc.hasCompactSupport
  have hKzero (p : G × G) (hp : p ∉ Sfg ×ˢ tsupport fc) : K p.1 p.2 = 0 := by
    by_cases ht : p.2 ∈ tsupport fc
    · have hs : p.1 ∉ Sfg := fun hs => hp ⟨hs, ht⟩
      have hg : p.2⁻¹ * p.1 ∉ tsupport gc := by
        intro hg
        apply hs
        simpa only [mul_inv_cancel_left] using Set.mul_mem_mul ht hg
      change ρ.algebra (fc p.2 * α p.2 (gc (p.2⁻¹ * p.1)))
        ((ρ.group p.1 : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) = 0
      rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hg, α.apply_zero, mul_zero, map_zero]
      rfl
    · change ρ.algebra (HaarTwistedCore.kernel α fc gc p.1 p.2)
        ((ρ.group p.1 : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) = 0
      rw [HaarTwistedCore.kernel_zero_of_notMem_tsupport_left α fc gc p.1 p.2 ht, map_zero]
      rfl
  have hKcompact : HasCompactSupport K.uncurry :=
    HasCompactSupport.intro' (hSfgcompact.prod fc.hasCompactSupport)
      (hSfgclosed.prod (isClosed_tsupport fc)) hKzero
  have hLeft :
      StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator μ ρ.group ρ.algebra
          (HaarTwistedCore.toCc μ α (f * g)) ξ =
        ∫ s : G, (∫ t : G, K s t ∂μ) ∂μ := by
    rw [StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator_apply]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun s => by
      let L : A →L[ℂ] H :=
        (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℂ H ((ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ)).comp P
      have hL := L.integral_comp_comm (HaarTwistedCore.integrable_kernel μ α fc gc s)
      change ρ.algebra (HaarTwistedCore.convolution μ α f g s)
        ((ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) = ∫ t : G, K s t ∂μ
      rw [HaarTwistedCore.convolution_apply]
      change L (∫ t : G, HaarTwistedCore.kernel α fc gc s t ∂μ) =
        ∫ t : G, L (HaarTwistedCore.kernel α fc gc s t) ∂μ
      exact hL.symm
  have hSwap : (∫ s : G, (∫ t : G, K s t ∂μ) ∂μ) =
      ∫ t : G, (∫ s : G, K s t ∂μ) ∂μ :=
    integral_integral_swap_of_hasCompactSupport hKcont hKcompact
  have hRight : (∫ t : G, (∫ s : G, K s t ∂μ) ∂μ) =
      StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator μ ρ.group ρ.algebra fc
        (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator μ ρ.group ρ.algebra gc ξ) := by
    change (∫ t : G, (∫ s : G, K s t ∂μ) ∂μ) =
      ∫ t : G, ρ.algebra (fc t) ((ρ.group t : H →L[ℂ] H)
        (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator μ ρ.group ρ.algebra gc ξ)) ∂μ
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun t => by
      let T : H →L[ℂ] H := ρ.algebra (fc t) * (ρ.group t : H →L[ℂ] H)
      have hPoint (r : G) : K (t * r) t =
          T (ρ.algebra (gc r) ((ρ.group r : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ)) := by
        have hU : (ρ.group (t * r) : H →L[ℂ] H) =
            (ρ.group t : H →L[ℂ] H) * (ρ.group r : H →L[ℂ] H) :=
          congrArg (fun u : unitary (H →L[ℂ] H) => (u : H →L[ℂ] H))
            (ρ.group.toMonoidHom.map_mul t r)
        have hu : star (ρ.group t : H →L[ℂ] H) * (ρ.group t : H →L[ℂ] H) = 1 :=
          (ρ.group t).prop.1
        have hCov : ρ.algebra (α t (gc r)) * (ρ.group t : H →L[ℂ] H) =
            (ρ.group t : H →L[ℂ] H) * ρ.algebra (gc r) := by
          rw [← ρ.covariance t (gc r)]
          simp only [mul_assoc, hu, mul_one]
        have hOp :
            ρ.algebra (fc t * α t (gc r)) * (ρ.group (t * r) : H →L[ℂ] H) =
              (ρ.algebra (fc t) * (ρ.group t : H →L[ℂ] H)) * ρ.algebra (gc r) *
                (ρ.group r : H →L[ℂ] H) := by
          rw [map_mul ρ.algebra, hU]
          calc
            (ρ.algebra (fc t) * ρ.algebra (α t (gc r))) *
                ((ρ.group t : H →L[ℂ] H) * (ρ.group r : H →L[ℂ] H)) =
              ρ.algebra (fc t) * (ρ.algebra (α t (gc r)) * (ρ.group t : H →L[ℂ] H)) *
                (ρ.group r : H →L[ℂ] H) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
            _ = ρ.algebra (fc t) *
                ((ρ.group t : H →L[ℂ] H) * ρ.algebra (gc r)) *
                  (ρ.group r : H →L[ℂ] H) := by rw [hCov]
            _ = (ρ.algebra (fc t) * (ρ.group t : H →L[ℂ] H)) * ρ.algebra (gc r) *
                (ρ.group r : H →L[ℂ] H) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
        change ρ.algebra (fc t * α t (gc (t⁻¹ * (t * r))))
          ((ρ.group (t * r) : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) = _
        rw [inv_mul_cancel_left]
        exact congrArg (fun B : H →L[ℂ] H => B ξ) hOp
      calc
        (∫ s : G, K s t ∂μ) = ∫ r : G, K (t * r) t ∂μ :=
          (integral_mul_left_eq_self (μ := μ) (fun s : G => K s t) t).symm
        _ = ∫ r : G, T (ρ.algebra (gc r) ((ρ.group r : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ)) ∂μ :=
          integral_congr_ae (Eventually.of_forall hPoint)
        _ = T (∫ r : G, ρ.algebra (gc r) ((ρ.group r : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) ∂μ) :=
          T.integral_comp_comm
            (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedVector_integrable
              μ ρ.group ρ.algebra gc ξ)
        _ = ρ.algebra (fc t) ((ρ.group t : H →L[ℂ] H)
            (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator
              μ ρ.group ρ.algebra gc ξ)) :=
          rfl
  exact hLeft.trans (hSwap.trans hRight)

/-- The original modularly weighted Haar involution acts by the actual Hilbert adjoint. -/
theorem haarIntegratedOperator_star (f : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :
    StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator μ ρ.group ρ.algebra
        (HaarTwistedCore.toCc μ α (star f)) =
      star (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator μ ρ.group ρ.algebra
        (HaarTwistedCore.toCc μ α f)) := by
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint]
  apply (ContinuousLinearMap.eq_adjoint_iff _ _).mpr
  intro ξ η
  let fc : C_c(G, A) := HaarTwistedCore.toCc μ α f
  let F : G → ℂ := fun s =>
    ⟪ξ, ρ.algebra (fc s) ((ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) η)⟫_ℂ
  have hFcont : Continuous F :=
    continuous_const.inner
      (((map_continuous ρ.algebra).comp fc.continuous).clm_apply
        (ρ.group.continuous_orbit η))
  have hFcompact : HasCompactSupport F := by
    refine HasCompactSupport.intro' fc.hasCompactSupport (isClosed_tsupport fc) ?_
    intro s hs
    change ⟪ξ, ρ.algebra (fc s) ((ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) η)⟫_ℂ = 0
    rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hs, map_zero]
    change ⟪ξ, (0 : H)⟫_ℂ = 0
    simp only [inner_zero_right]
  have hPoint (s : G) :
      ⟪ρ.algebra ((star f) s) ((ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ), η⟫_ℂ =
        (Measure.modularCharacter s : ℝ) • F s⁻¹ := by
    have hu : star (ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) * (ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) = 1 :=
      (ρ.group s).prop.1
    have hCov : ρ.algebra (α s (star (fc s⁻¹))) * (ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) =
        (ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) * star (ρ.algebra (fc s⁻¹)) := by
      rw [← ρ.covariance s (star (fc s⁻¹)), StarHomClass.map_star ρ.algebra (fc s⁻¹)]
      simp only [mul_assoc, hu, mul_one]
    have hInv : star (ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) = (ρ.group s⁻¹ : H →L[ℂ] H) :=
      congrArg (fun u : unitary (H →L[ℂ] H) => (u : H →L[ℂ] H))
        (ρ.group.toMonoidHom.map_inv s).symm
    change ⟪ρ.algebra (HaarTwistedCore.crossedStar μ α f s)
      ((ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ), η⟫_ℂ = _
    rw [HaarTwistedCore.crossedStar_apply, map_smul]
    simp only [_root_.smul_apply]
    change ⟪((Measure.modularCharacter s : ℝ) : ℂ) •
      (ρ.algebra (α s (star (fc s⁻¹))) ((ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) : H), η⟫_ℂ = _
    refine (inner_smul_real_left (𝕜 := ℂ)
      (ρ.algebra (α s (star (fc s⁻¹))) ((ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ))
      η (Measure.modularCharacter s : ℝ)).trans ?_
    change (Measure.modularCharacter s : ℝ) •
      ⟪(ρ.algebra (α s (star (fc s⁻¹))) * (ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H)) ξ, η⟫_ℂ = _
    rw [hCov]
    apply congrArg (fun z : ℂ => (Measure.modularCharacter s : ℝ) • z)
    change ⟪(ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) (star (ρ.algebra (fc s⁻¹)) ξ), η⟫_ℂ =
      ⟪ξ, ρ.algebra (fc s⁻¹) ((ρ.group s⁻¹ : H →L[ℂ] H) η)⟫_ℂ
    calc
      _ = ⟪star (ρ.algebra (fc s⁻¹)) ξ, star (ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) η⟫_ℂ :=
        (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right (ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H)
          (star (ρ.algebra (fc s⁻¹)) ξ) η).symm
      _ = ⟪ξ, ρ.algebra (fc s⁻¹) (star (ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) η)⟫_ℂ :=
        ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left (ρ.algebra (fc s⁻¹))
          (star (ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) η) ξ
      _ = _ := by rw [hInv]
  have hLeft :
      (∫ s : G, ⟪ρ.algebra ((star f) s) ((ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ), η⟫_ℂ ∂μ) =
        ⟪StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator μ ρ.group ρ.algebra
          (HaarTwistedCore.toCc μ α (star f)) ξ, η⟫_ℂ :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.integral_comp_commSL (by intro r z; simp) (innerSLFlip ℂ η)
      (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedVector_integrable μ ρ.group ρ.algebra
        (HaarTwistedCore.toCc μ α (star f)) ξ)
  have hRight : (∫ s : G, F s ∂μ) =
      ⟪ξ, StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator μ ρ.group ρ.algebra fc η⟫_ℂ :=
    (innerSL ℂ ξ).integral_comp_comm
      (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedVector_integrable μ ρ.group ρ.algebra fc η)
  calc
    _ = ∫ s : G, ⟪ρ.algebra ((star f) s) ((ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ), η⟫_ℂ ∂μ := hLeft.symm
    _ = ∫ s : G, (Measure.modularCharacter s : ℝ) • F s⁻¹ ∂μ :=
      integral_congr_ae (Eventually.of_forall hPoint)
    _ = ∫ s : G, F s ∂μ :=
      integral_modularCharacter_smul_inv_of_hasCompactSupport μ hFcont hFcompact
    _ = _ := hRight

/-- The actual Haar core homomorphism whose values are the original vector-integrated operators. -/
def haarIntegratedHom : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H) where
  toFun f := StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator μ ρ.group ρ.algebra
    (HaarTwistedCore.toCc μ α f)
  map_zero' := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro ξ
    rw [StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator_apply,
      HaarTwistedCore.toCc_zero]
    simp only [CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.zero_apply, map_zero]
    change (∫ _ : G, (0 : H) ∂μ) = (0 : H)
    exact integral_zero G H
  map_add' := by
    intro f g
    rw [HaarTwistedCore.toCc_add]
    exact StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator_add μ ρ.group ρ.algebra _ _
  map_mul' := haarIntegratedOperator_mul μ ρ
  map_smul' := by
    intro c f
    change StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator μ ρ.group ρ.algebra
        (HaarTwistedCore.toCc μ α (c • f)) =
      c • StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator μ ρ.group ρ.algebra
        (HaarTwistedCore.toCc μ α f)
    rw [HaarTwistedCore.toCc_smul]
    exact StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator_smul μ ρ.group ρ.algebra _ _
  map_star' := haarIntegratedOperator_star μ ρ

/-- The computed homomorphism value is the original integrated operator on the same coefficient. -/
@[simp]
theorem haarIntegratedHom_apply (f : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :
    haarIntegratedHom μ ρ f =
      StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.integratedOperator μ ρ.group ρ.algebra
        (HaarTwistedCore.toCc μ α f) :=
  rfl

/-- Every Hilbert-vector action is the literal original integrated covariant formula. -/
theorem haarIntegratedHom_apply_vector (f : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) (ξ : H) :
    haarIntegratedHom μ ρ f ξ =
      ∫ s : G, ρ.algebra (f s) ((ρ.group s : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) ∂μ :=
  rfl

/-- The actual integrated homomorphism has the original Haar L1 coefficient bound. -/
theorem norm_haarIntegratedHom_le (f : HaarTwistedCore.Carrier μ α) :
    ‖haarIntegratedHom μ ρ f‖ ≤ ∫ s : G, ‖f s‖ ∂μ :=
  StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.norm_integratedOperator_le μ ρ.group ρ.algebra
    (HaarTwistedCore.toCc μ α f)

end

end CovariantRepresentation

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.StarRing
public import MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.Group.HaarWeightedInversion
public import Mathlib.Topology.ContinuousMap.CocompactMap
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Mul

/-!
# The original left and right actions on the Haar twisted core

The compact-support functions and the measure/action-indexed carrier remain the
original ones. Coefficients act by left multiplication and by the action-valued
right coefficient. Group elements act by inverse left translation with the
coefficient action, and by right translation with the right-pushforward modular
factor. The identities here are the algebraic prerequisites of the canonical
coefficient and group multiplier maps on the actual completed crossed product.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped CompactlySupported Pointwise NNReal CStarAlgebra

namespace HaarTwistedCore

noncomputable section

universe uG uA

section CoefficientCc

variable {G : Type uG} [TopologicalSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

/-- A coefficient multiplies the original compact-support function on the left. -/
def coefficientLeftCc (a : A) : C_c(G, A) →ₗ[ℂ] C_c(G, A) where
  toFun f :=
    { toFun s := a * f s
      continuous_toFun := continuous_const.mul (map_continuous f)
      hasCompactSupport' := f.hasCompactSupport.mul_left }
  map_add' f h := by
    apply CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.ext
    intro s
    change a * (f s + h s) = a * f s + a * h s
    exact mul_add _ _ _
  map_smul' c f := by
    apply CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.ext
    intro s
    change a * (c • f s) = c • (a * f s)
    exact mul_smul_comm _ _ _

/-- The left coefficient action has the literal original pointwise value. -/
@[simp]
theorem coefficientLeftCc_apply (a : A) (f : C_c(G, A)) (s : G) :
    coefficientLeftCc a f s = a * f s := rfl

section Monoid

variable [Monoid G] (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

/-- A coefficient multiplies on the right through the original point-norm action. -/
def coefficientRightCc (a : A) : C_c(G, A) →ₗ[ℂ] C_c(G, A) where
  toFun f :=
    { toFun s := f s * α s a
      continuous_toFun := (map_continuous f).mul
        (α.continuous_apply continuous_id continuous_const)
      hasCompactSupport' := f.hasCompactSupport.mul_right }
  map_add' f h := by
    apply CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.ext
    intro s
    change (f s + h s) * α s a = f s * α s a + h s * α s a
    exact add_mul _ _ _
  map_smul' c f := by
    apply CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.ext
    intro s
    change (c • f s) * α s a = c • (f s * α s a)
    exact smul_mul_assoc _ _ _

/-- The right coefficient action has the original action-valued coefficient. -/
@[simp]
theorem coefficientRightCc_apply (a : A) (f : C_c(G, A)) (s : G) :
    coefficientRightCc α a f s = f s * α s a := rfl

end Monoid
end CoefficientCc

section GroupCc

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

/-- Inverse left translation and the original coefficient action on C_c. -/
def groupLeftCc (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (g : G) : C_c(G, A) →ₗ[ℂ] C_c(G, A) where
  toFun f :=
    { toFun s := α g (f (g⁻¹ * s))
      continuous_toFun := α.continuous_apply continuous_const
        ((map_continuous f).comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_id))
      hasCompactSupport' :=
        (f.comp (Homeomorph.mulLeft g⁻¹).toCocompactMap).hasCompactSupport.comp_left
          (α.apply_zero g) }
  map_add' f h := by
    apply CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.ext
    intro s
    change α g (f (g⁻¹ * s) + h (g⁻¹ * s)) =
      α g (f (g⁻¹ * s)) + α g (h (g⁻¹ * s))
    exact α.apply_add _ _ _
  map_smul' c f := by
    apply CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.ext
    intro s
    change α g (c • f (g⁻¹ * s)) = c • α g (f (g⁻¹ * s))
    exact α.apply_smul _ _ _

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] in
/-- The original left group action retains its inverse-translation formula. -/
@[simp]
theorem groupLeftCc_apply (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (g : G) (f : C_c(G, A)) (s : G) :
    groupLeftCc α g f s = α g (f (g⁻¹ * s)) := rfl

/-- Right translation has precisely the adopted right-pushforward modular factor. -/
def groupRightCc (g : G) : C_c(G, A) →ₗ[ℂ] C_c(G, A) :=
  ((Measure.modularCharacter g : ℝ) : ℂ) •
    CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.compLinearMap (R := ℂ) (Homeomorph.mulRight g⁻¹).toCocompactMap

/-- The original right group action has the printed Haar factor. -/
@[simp]
theorem groupRightCc_apply (g : G) (f : C_c(G, A)) (s : G) :
    groupRightCc g f s = ((Measure.modularCharacter g : ℝ) : ℂ) • f (s * g⁻¹) := rfl

end GroupCc

section CoreCoefficient

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (μ : Measure G) (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

/-- The actual left coefficient map on the same original indexed carrier. -/
def coefficientLeft (a : A) : Carrier μ α →ₗ[ℂ] Carrier μ α where
  toFun f := fromCc μ α (coefficientLeftCc a (toCc μ α f))
  map_add' f h := by
    apply (equivCc μ α).injective
    change coefficientLeftCc a (toCc μ α (f + h)) =
      toCc μ α (fromCc μ α (coefficientLeftCc a (toCc μ α f)) +
        fromCc μ α (coefficientLeftCc a (toCc μ α h)))
    simp only [toCc_add, toCc_fromCc, map_add]
  map_smul' c f := by
    apply (equivCc μ α).injective
    change coefficientLeftCc a (toCc μ α (c • f)) =
      toCc μ α (c • fromCc μ α (coefficientLeftCc a (toCc μ α f)))
    simp only [toCc_smul, toCc_fromCc, map_smul]

/-- Left coefficient evaluation retains the same original function value. -/
@[simp]
theorem coefficientLeft_apply (a : A) (f : Carrier μ α) (s : G) :
    coefficientLeft μ α a f s = a * f s := rfl

/-- The actual right coefficient map on the same original indexed carrier. -/
def coefficientRight (a : A) : Carrier μ α →ₗ[ℂ] Carrier μ α where
  toFun f := fromCc μ α (coefficientRightCc α a (toCc μ α f))
  map_add' f h := by
    apply (equivCc μ α).injective
    change coefficientRightCc α a (toCc μ α (f + h)) =
      toCc μ α (fromCc μ α (coefficientRightCc α a (toCc μ α f)) +
        fromCc μ α (coefficientRightCc α a (toCc μ α h)))
    simp only [toCc_add, toCc_fromCc, map_add]
  map_smul' c f := by
    apply (equivCc μ α).injective
    change coefficientRightCc α a (toCc μ α (c • f)) =
      toCc μ α (c • fromCc μ α (coefficientRightCc α a (toCc μ α f)))
    simp only [toCc_smul, toCc_fromCc, map_smul]

/-- Right coefficient evaluation retains the original action-valued coefficient. -/
@[simp]
theorem coefficientRight_apply (a : A) (f : Carrier μ α) (s : G) :
    coefficientRight μ α a f s = f s * α s a := rfl

/-- Original left coefficients compose by their original product. -/
theorem coefficientLeft_mul (a b : A) :
    coefficientLeft μ α (a * b) = (coefficientLeft μ α a).comp (coefficientLeft μ α b) := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro f
  apply ext μ α
  intro s
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, coefficientLeft_apply, mul_assoc]

/-- Original right coefficients compose in the double-centralizer order. -/
theorem coefficientRight_mul (a b : A) :
    coefficientRight μ α (a * b) = (coefficientRight μ α b).comp (coefficientRight μ α a) := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro f
  apply ext μ α
  intro s
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, coefficientRight_apply, α.apply_mul_elem, mul_assoc]

/-- The original left coefficient parameter is additive. -/
theorem coefficientLeft_add (a b : A) :
    coefficientLeft μ α (a + b) = coefficientLeft μ α a + coefficientLeft μ α b := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro f
  apply ext μ α
  intro s
  simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, coefficientLeft_apply, toCc_add,
    CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.add_apply, add_mul]

/-- The original right coefficient parameter is additive. -/
theorem coefficientRight_add (a b : A) :
    coefficientRight μ α (a + b) = coefficientRight μ α a + coefficientRight μ α b := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro f
  apply ext μ α
  intro s
  simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, coefficientRight_apply, toCc_add,
    CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.add_apply, α.apply_add, mul_add]

/-- The original left coefficient parameter has its actual complex scaling. -/
theorem coefficientLeft_smul (c : ℂ) (a : A) :
    coefficientLeft μ α (c • a) = c • coefficientLeft μ α a := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro f
  apply ext μ α
  intro s
  simp only [LinearMap.smul_apply, coefficientLeft_apply, toCc_smul,
    CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.smul_apply, smul_mul_assoc]

/-- The original right coefficient parameter has its actual complex scaling. -/
theorem coefficientRight_smul (c : ℂ) (a : A) :
    coefficientRight μ α (c • a) = c • coefficientRight μ α a := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro f
  apply ext μ α
  intro s
  simp only [LinearMap.smul_apply, coefficientRight_apply, toCc_smul,
    CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.smul_apply, α.apply_smul, mul_smul_comm]

end CoreCoefficient

section CoreGroup

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (μ : Measure G) (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

/-- The actual inverse left group action on the same indexed compact-support functions. -/
def groupLeft (g : G) : Carrier μ α →ₗ[ℂ] Carrier μ α where
  toFun f := fromCc μ α (groupLeftCc α g (toCc μ α f))
  map_add' f h := by
    apply (equivCc μ α).injective
    change groupLeftCc α g (toCc μ α (f + h)) =
      toCc μ α (fromCc μ α (groupLeftCc α g (toCc μ α f)) +
        fromCc μ α (groupLeftCc α g (toCc μ α h)))
    simp only [toCc_add, toCc_fromCc, map_add]
  map_smul' c f := by
    apply (equivCc μ α).injective
    change groupLeftCc α g (toCc μ α (c • f)) =
      toCc μ α (c • fromCc μ α (groupLeftCc α g (toCc μ α f)))
    simp only [toCc_smul, toCc_fromCc, map_smul]

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] in
/-- The indexed left group action retains every original inverse-translation value. -/
@[simp]
theorem groupLeft_apply (g : G) (f : Carrier μ α) (s : G) :
    groupLeft μ α g f s = α g (f (g⁻¹ * s)) := rfl

/-- The actual modular right group action on the same indexed compact-support functions. -/
def groupRight (g : G) : Carrier μ α →ₗ[ℂ] Carrier μ α where
  toFun f := fromCc μ α (groupRightCc g (toCc μ α f))
  map_add' f h := by
    apply (equivCc μ α).injective
    change groupRightCc g (toCc μ α (f + h)) =
      toCc μ α (fromCc μ α (groupRightCc g (toCc μ α f)) +
        fromCc μ α (groupRightCc g (toCc μ α h)))
    simp only [toCc_add, toCc_fromCc, map_add]
  map_smul' c f := by
    apply (equivCc μ α).injective
    change groupRightCc g (toCc μ α (c • f)) =
      toCc μ α (c • fromCc μ α (groupRightCc g (toCc μ α f)))
    simp only [toCc_smul, toCc_fromCc, map_smul]

/-- The indexed right group action retains the adopted modular factor. -/
@[simp]
theorem groupRight_apply (g : G) (f : Carrier μ α) (s : G) :
    groupRight μ α g f s = ((Measure.modularCharacter g : ℝ) : ℂ) • f (s * g⁻¹) := rfl

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] in
/-- The original left group identity acts as the actual identity map. -/
theorem groupLeft_one : groupLeft μ α 1 = LinearMap.id := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro f
  apply ext μ α
  intro s
  simp only [groupLeft_apply, inv_one, one_mul, α.apply_one, LinearMap.id_apply]

/-- The original right group identity acts as the actual identity map. -/
theorem groupRight_one : groupRight μ α 1 = LinearMap.id := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro f
  apply ext μ α
  intro s
  simp only [groupRight_apply, map_one, NNReal.coe_one, Complex.ofReal_one,
    inv_one, mul_one, one_smul, LinearMap.id_apply]

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] in
/-- Original left group actions compose in the source group order. -/
theorem groupLeft_mul (g h : G) :
    groupLeft μ α (g * h) = (groupLeft μ α g).comp (groupLeft μ α h) := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro f
  apply ext μ α
  intro s
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, groupLeft_apply, α.apply_mul, mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc]

/-- Original right group actions compose in the double-centralizer order. -/
theorem groupRight_mul (g h : G) :
    groupRight μ α (g * h) = (groupRight μ α h).comp (groupRight μ α g) := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro f
  apply ext μ α
  intro s
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, groupRight_apply, map_mul, NNReal.coe_mul,
    Complex.ofReal_mul, mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc, smul_smul]
  rw [mul_comm (((Measure.modularCharacter g : ℝ) : ℂ))
    (((Measure.modularCharacter h : ℝ) : ℂ))]

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] in
/-- The source left group and coefficient actions obey the actual covariance equation. -/
theorem groupLeft_coefficientLeft (g : G) (a : A) :
    (groupLeft μ α g).comp (coefficientLeft μ α a) =
      (coefficientLeft μ α (α g a)).comp (groupLeft μ α g) := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro f
  apply ext μ α
  intro s
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, groupLeft_apply, coefficientLeft_apply, α.apply_mul_elem]

/-- The source right group and coefficient actions obey the second covariance component. -/
theorem coefficientRight_groupRight (g : G) (a : A) :
    (coefficientRight μ α a).comp (groupRight μ α g) =
      (groupRight μ α g).comp (coefficientRight μ α (α g a)) := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro f
  apply ext μ α
  intro s
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, coefficientRight_apply, groupRight_apply]
  have ha : α (s * g⁻¹) (α g a) = α s a := by
    rw [← α.apply_mul, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel, mul_one]
  change (α.aut (s * g⁻¹)) ((α.aut g) a) = (α.aut s) a at ha
  rw [ha, smul_mul_assoc]

end CoreGroup

section CoreStar

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (μ : Measure G) (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

/-- The source star exchanges the left coefficient with the adjoint right coefficient. -/
theorem crossedStar_coefficientLeft (a : A) (f : Carrier μ α) :
    crossedStar μ α (coefficientLeft μ α a f) =
      coefficientRight μ α (star a) (crossedStar μ α f) := by
  apply ext μ α
  intro s
  simp only [crossedStar_apply, coefficientLeft_apply, coefficientRight_apply,
    star_mul, α.apply_mul_elem, smul_mul_assoc]

/-- The source star exchanges the right coefficient with the adjoint left coefficient. -/
theorem crossedStar_coefficientRight (a : A) (f : Carrier μ α) :
    crossedStar μ α (coefficientRight μ α a f) =
      coefficientLeft μ α (star a) (crossedStar μ α f) := by
  apply ext μ α
  intro s
  rw [crossedStar_apply, coefficientRight_apply, coefficientLeft_apply, crossedStar_apply]
  rw [star_mul, ← α.apply_star, α.apply_mul_elem, α.apply_apply_inv, mul_smul_comm]

/-- The source star exchanges inverse left translation with inverse right translation. -/
theorem crossedStar_groupLeft (g : G) (f : Carrier μ α) :
    crossedStar μ α (groupLeft μ α g f) =
      groupRight μ α g⁻¹ (crossedStar μ α f) := by
  apply ext μ α
  intro s
  have hδ : Measure.modularCharacter g⁻¹ * Measure.modularCharacter (s * g) =
      Measure.modularCharacter s := by
    rw [map_mul, mul_left_comm, ← map_mul, inv_mul_cancel, map_one, mul_one]
  have hd : ((Measure.modularCharacter g⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      ((Measure.modularCharacter (s * g) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
        ((Measure.modularCharacter s : ℝ) : ℂ) := by exact_mod_cast hδ
  rw [crossedStar_apply, groupLeft_apply, groupRight_apply, crossedStar_apply, inv_inv]
  rw [← α.apply_star, ← α.apply_mul, mul_inv_rev, smul_smul, hd]

/-- The source star exchanges modular right translation with inverse left translation. -/
theorem crossedStar_groupRight (g : G) (f : Carrier μ α) :
    crossedStar μ α (groupRight μ α g f) =
      groupLeft μ α g⁻¹ (crossedStar μ α f) := by
  apply ext μ α
  intro s
  have hstar : star ((Measure.modularCharacter g : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      ((Measure.modularCharacter g : ℝ) : ℂ) := by simp
  have hδ : Measure.modularCharacter s * Measure.modularCharacter g =
      Measure.modularCharacter (g * s) := by rw [map_mul, mul_comm]
  have hd : ((Measure.modularCharacter s : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      ((Measure.modularCharacter g : ℝ) : ℂ) =
        ((Measure.modularCharacter (g * s) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by exact_mod_cast hδ
  rw [crossedStar_apply, groupRight_apply, groupLeft_apply, crossedStar_apply, inv_inv]
  rw [star_smul, hstar, α.apply_smul, α.apply_smul, ← α.apply_mul,
    inv_mul_cancel_left, mul_inv_rev, smul_smul, hd]

end CoreStar

section CoreCompatibility

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular] (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [μ.Regular] in
/-- Left coefficients are the original left centralizers of Haar convolution. -/
theorem coefficientLeft_convolution (a : A) (f h : Carrier μ α) :
    coefficientLeft μ α a (convolution μ α f h) =
      convolution μ α (coefficientLeft μ α a f) h := by
  apply ext μ α
  intro s
  let : NormedSpace ℝ A := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ A
  rw [coefficientLeft_apply, convolution_apply, convolution_apply]
  simp_rw [coefficientLeft_apply]
  let L : A →L[ℂ] A := ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ A a
  have hL (z : A) : L z = a * z := rfl
  calc
    a * (∫ t : G, f t * α t (h (t⁻¹ * s)) ∂μ) =
        L (∫ t : G, kernel α (toCc μ α f) (toCc μ α h) s t ∂μ) := rfl
    _ = ∫ t : G, L (kernel α (toCc μ α f) (toCc μ α h) s t) ∂μ :=
      (L.integral_comp_comm (integrable_kernel μ α (toCc μ α f) (toCc μ α h) s)).symm
    _ = ∫ t : G, (a * f t) * α t (h (t⁻¹ * s)) ∂μ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [] with t
      rw [hL, kernel]
      exact (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [μ.Regular] in
/-- Right coefficients are the original right centralizers of Haar convolution. -/
theorem coefficientRight_convolution (a : A) (f h : Carrier μ α) :
    coefficientRight μ α a (convolution μ α f h) =
      convolution μ α f (coefficientRight μ α a h) := by
  apply ext μ α
  intro s
  let : NormedSpace ℝ A := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ A
  rw [coefficientRight_apply, convolution_apply, convolution_apply]
  simp_rw [coefficientRight_apply]
  let R : A →L[ℂ] A := (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ A).flip (α s a)
  have hR (z : A) : R z = z * α s a := rfl
  calc
    (∫ t : G, f t * α t (h (t⁻¹ * s)) ∂μ) * α s a =
        R (∫ t : G, kernel α (toCc μ α f) (toCc μ α h) s t ∂μ) := rfl
    _ = ∫ t : G, R (kernel α (toCc μ α f) (toCc μ α h) s t) ∂μ :=
      (R.integral_comp_comm (integrable_kernel μ α (toCc μ α f) (toCc μ α h) s)).symm
    _ = ∫ t : G, f t * α t (h (t⁻¹ * s) * α (t⁻¹ * s) a) ∂μ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [] with t
      have ha : α t (α (t⁻¹ * s) a) = α s a := by
        rw [← α.apply_mul, mul_inv_cancel_left]
      rw [hR, kernel]
      change (α.aut t) ((α.aut (t⁻¹ * s)) a) = (α.aut s) a at ha
      rw [map_mul (α.aut t), ha]
      exact mul_assoc _ _ _

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [μ.Regular] in
/-- The two original coefficient actions form one compatible centralizer pair. -/
theorem convolution_coefficientLeft (a : A) (f h : Carrier μ α) :
    convolution μ α f (coefficientLeft μ α a h) =
      convolution μ α (coefficientRight μ α a f) h := by
  apply ext μ α
  intro s
  let : NormedSpace ℝ A := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ A
  rw [convolution_apply, convolution_apply]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [] with t
  rw [coefficientLeft_apply, coefficientRight_apply, map_mul (α.aut t), mul_assoc]

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [μ.Regular] in
/-- Original inverse left translation is the left centralizer of Haar convolution. -/
theorem groupLeft_convolution (g : G) (f h : Carrier μ α) :
    groupLeft μ α g (convolution μ α f h) =
      convolution μ α (groupLeft μ α g f) h := by
  apply ext μ α
  intro s
  let : NormedSpace ℝ A := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ A
  rw [groupLeft_apply, convolution_apply, convolution_apply]
  let T : A →L[ℂ] A :=
    ⟨LinearMap.ofClass (α.aut g), (StarAlgEquiv.isometry (α.aut g)).continuous⟩
  have hT (z : A) : T z = α g z := rfl
  let K : G → A := fun u => α g (f (g⁻¹ * u)) * α u (h (u⁻¹ * s))
  have hPoint (t : G) :
      T (kernel α (toCc μ α f) (toCc μ α h) (g⁻¹ * s) t) = K (g * t) := by
    rw [hT, kernel]
    simp only [K, α.apply_mul_elem, α.apply_mul, inv_mul_cancel_left,
      mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc]
  calc
    α g (∫ t : G, f t * α t (h (t⁻¹ * (g⁻¹ * s))) ∂μ) =
        T (∫ t : G, kernel α (toCc μ α f) (toCc μ α h) (g⁻¹ * s) t ∂μ) := rfl
    _ = ∫ t : G, T (kernel α (toCc μ α f) (toCc μ α h) (g⁻¹ * s) t) ∂μ :=
      (T.integral_comp_comm (integrable_kernel μ α (toCc μ α f) (toCc μ α h) (g⁻¹ * s))).symm
    _ = ∫ t : G, K (g * t) ∂μ := integral_congr_ae (Eventually.of_forall hPoint)
    _ = ∫ u : G, K u ∂μ := integral_mul_left_eq_self (μ := μ) K g
    _ = ∫ u : G, groupLeft μ α g f u * α u (h (u⁻¹ * s)) ∂μ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [] with u
      rw [groupLeft_apply]

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- Original modular right translation is the right centralizer of Haar convolution. -/
theorem groupRight_convolution (g : G) (f h : Carrier μ α) :
    groupRight μ α g (convolution μ α f h) =
      convolution μ α f (groupRight μ α g h) := by
  apply ext μ α
  intro s
  let : NormedSpace ℝ A := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ A
  rw [groupRight_apply, convolution_apply, convolution_apply]
  calc
    ((Measure.modularCharacter g : ℝ) : ℂ) •
        (∫ t : G, f t * α t (h (t⁻¹ * (s * g⁻¹))) ∂μ) =
      ∫ t : G, ((Measure.modularCharacter g : ℝ) : ℂ) •
        (f t * α t (h (t⁻¹ * (s * g⁻¹)))) ∂μ := (integral_smul _ _).symm
    _ = ∫ t : G, f t * α t (groupRight μ α g h (t⁻¹ * s)) ∂μ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [] with t
      rw [groupRight_apply, map_smul (α.aut t), mul_smul_comm, mul_assoc]

/-- Original left and modular right translations form the source centralizer pair. -/
theorem convolution_groupLeft (g : G) (f h : Carrier μ α) :
    convolution μ α f (groupLeft μ α g h) =
      convolution μ α (groupRight μ α g f) h := by
  apply ext μ α
  intro s
  let : NormedSpace ℝ A := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ A
  rw [convolution_apply, convolution_apply]
  let K : G → A := fun u => f (u * g⁻¹) * α u (h (u⁻¹ * s))
  have hPoint (t : G) : f t * α t (groupLeft μ α g h (t⁻¹ * s)) = K (t * g) := by
    rw [groupLeft_apply]
    simp only [K, α.apply_mul, mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc]
    rw [mul_inv_cancel, mul_one]
  calc
    (∫ t : G, f t * α t (groupLeft μ α g h (t⁻¹ * s)) ∂μ) =
        ∫ t : G, K (t * g) ∂μ := integral_congr_ae (Eventually.of_forall hPoint)
    _ = (Measure.modularCharacter g : ℝ) • ∫ u : G, K u ∂μ :=
      MeasureTheory.integral_mul_right_modular μ K g
    _ = ((Measure.modularCharacter g : ℝ) : ℂ) • ∫ u : G, K u ∂μ := rfl
    _ = ∫ u : G, ((Measure.modularCharacter g : ℝ) : ℂ) • K u ∂μ :=
      (integral_smul _ _).symm
    _ = ∫ u : G, groupRight μ α g f u * α u (h (u⁻¹ * s)) ∂μ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [] with u
      rw [groupRight_apply, smul_mul_assoc]

end CoreCompatibility

end

end HaarTwistedCore

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.MultiplierActions
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.SeminormNonUnitalCompletion
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.SquareComplement
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Unitization

/-!
# Original coefficient bounds in every actual C-star seminorm completion

The coefficient action extends to the real C-star unitization by the standard
algebraic toAlgHom construction. A positive CFC square complement in that
unitization gives the original cross-Gram square identity on the Haar core.
The genuine same-seminorm separated completion then gives the coefficient
norm bounds. No raw-core or L1 C-star structure, supplied bound, positive
model or null-kernel conclusion is an input. The zero seminorm is allowed.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped CStarAlgebra

namespace HaarTwistedCore

noncomputable section

universe uG uA

section UnitizedActions

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure G) (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

/-- Original left coefficient multiplication as its actual algebraic endomorphism representation. -/
def coefficientLeftHom : A →ₙₐ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ (Carrier μ α) where
  toFun := coefficientLeft μ α
  map_zero' := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro f
    apply ext μ α
    intro s
    simp only [coefficientLeft_apply, zero_mul, LinearMap.zero_apply]
    rfl
  map_add' := coefficientLeft_add μ α
  map_mul' := coefficientLeft_mul μ α
  map_smul' := coefficientLeft_smul μ α

/-- The actual unitized action, constructed by the existing canonical toAlgHom API. -/
def coefficientLeftUnitization : Unitization ℂ A →ₐ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ (Carrier μ α) :=
  (coefficientLeftHom μ α).toAlgHom

/-- Unitized coefficients act by their original scalar and coefficient components. -/
@[simp]
theorem coefficientLeftUnitization_apply (a : Unitization ℂ A) (f : Carrier μ α) :
    coefficientLeftUnitization μ α a f = a.fst • f + coefficientLeft μ α a.snd f :=
  rfl

/-- Every original pointwise value of the computed unitized coefficient action. -/
@[simp]
theorem coefficientLeftUnitization_apply_pointwise
    (a : Unitization ℂ A) (f : Carrier μ α) (s : G) :
    coefficientLeftUnitization μ α a f s = a.fst • f s + a.snd * f s :=
  rfl

/-- The non-scalar unitization inclusion has exactly the original coefficient action. -/
@[simp]
theorem coefficientLeftUnitization_inr (a : A) :
    coefficientLeftUnitization μ α (a : Unitization ℂ A) = coefficientLeft μ α a := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro f
  simp only [coefficientLeftUnitization_apply, Unitization.fst_inr,
    Unitization.snd_inr, zero_smul, zero_add]

/-- The actual real scalar in the coefficient unitization acts by its original complex scalar. -/
theorem coefficientLeftUnitization_algebraMap (r : ℝ) (f : Carrier μ α) :
    coefficientLeftUnitization μ α (algebraMap ℝ (Unitization ℂ A) r) f = (r : ℂ) • f := by
  change coefficientLeftUnitization μ α (Unitization.inl (r : ℂ)) f = (r : ℂ) • f
  have hzero : coefficientLeft μ α (0 : A) = (0 : Module.End ℂ (Carrier μ α)) :=
    (coefficientLeftHom μ α).map_zero
  simp only [coefficientLeftUnitization_apply, Unitization.fst_inl,
    Unitization.snd_inl, hzero, LinearMap.zero_apply, add_zero]

end UnitizedActions

section SquareComplement

variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

/-- The computed positive CFC square complement of the original coefficient in its real unitization. -/
def coefficientSquareComplement (a : A) : Unitization ℂ A := by
  let : PartialOrder (Unitization ℂ A) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder _
  let : StarOrderedRing (Unitization ℂ A) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing _
  exact CStarAlgebra.normSquareComplement (a : Unitization ℂ A)

/-- The real unitization retains the original coefficient norm in the computed square identity. -/
theorem coefficientSquareComplement_identity (a : A) :
    star (a : Unitization ℂ A) * (a : Unitization ℂ A) +
      star (coefficientSquareComplement a) * coefficientSquareComplement a =
        algebraMap ℝ (Unitization ℂ A) (‖a‖ ^ 2) := by
  let : PartialOrder (Unitization ℂ A) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder _
  let : StarOrderedRing (Unitization ℂ A) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing _
  simpa only [coefficientSquareComplement, Unitization.norm_inr] using
    CStarAlgebra.star_mul_self_add_normSquareComplement (a : Unitization ℂ A)

end SquareComplement

section OriginalGramIdentities

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular]
variable (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- Original coefficient star exchange and convolution compatibility for the actual unitization. -/
theorem coefficientLeftUnitization_star_mul (a : Unitization ℂ A) (f h : Carrier μ α) :
    star (coefficientLeftUnitization μ α a f) * h =
      star f * coefficientLeftUnitization μ α (star a) h := by
  have hStar : star (coefficientLeft μ α a.snd f) =
      coefficientRight μ α (star a.snd) (star f) :=
    crossedStar_coefficientLeft μ α a.snd f
  have hCentral : star f * coefficientLeft μ α (star a.snd) h =
      coefficientRight μ α (star a.snd) (star f) * h :=
    convolution_coefficientLeft μ α (star a.snd) (star f) h
  calc
    _ = (star a.fst • star f + coefficientRight μ α (star a.snd) (star f)) * h := by
      rw [coefficientLeftUnitization_apply, star_add, star_smul, hStar]
    _ = star a.fst • (star f * h) + coefficientRight μ α (star a.snd) (star f) * h := by
      rw [add_mul, smul_mul_assoc]
    _ = star a.fst • (star f * h) + star f * coefficientLeft μ α (star a.snd) h := by
      rw [← hCentral]
    _ = star f * (star a.fst • h + coefficientLeft μ α (star a.snd) h) := by
      rw [mul_add, mul_smul_comm]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [coefficientLeftUnitization_apply, Unitization.fst_star, Unitization.snd_star]

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- The actual coefficient and computed positive complement give the original cross-Gram identity. -/
theorem coefficientLeft_cross_gram_square (a : A) (f h : Carrier μ α) :
    star (coefficientLeft μ α a f) * coefficientLeft μ α a h +
      star (coefficientLeftUnitization μ α (coefficientSquareComplement a) f) *
        coefficientLeftUnitization μ α (coefficientSquareComplement a) h =
      ((‖a‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) • (star f * h) := by
  let L := coefficientLeftUnitization μ α
  let c := coefficientSquareComplement a
  have hMul (x y : Unitization ℂ A) : L (x * y) h = L x (L y h) :=
    congrArg (fun T : Module.End ℂ (Carrier μ α) => T h) (map_mul L x y)
  have hAdd (x y : Unitization ℂ A) : L (x + y) h = L x h + L y h :=
    congrArg (fun T : Module.End ℂ (Carrier μ α) => T h) (map_add L x y)
  rw [← coefficientLeftUnitization_inr μ α a]
  change star (L (a : Unitization ℂ A) f) * L (a : Unitization ℂ A) h +
    star (L c f) * L c h = _
  calc
    _ = star f * L (star (a : Unitization ℂ A)) (L (a : Unitization ℂ A) h) +
        star f * L (star c) (L c h) := by
      rw [coefficientLeftUnitization_star_mul, coefficientLeftUnitization_star_mul]
    _ = star f * L (star (a : Unitization ℂ A) * (a : Unitization ℂ A)) h +
        star f * L (star c * c) h := by
      rw [← hMul, ← hMul]
    _ = star f * (L (star (a : Unitization ℂ A) * (a : Unitization ℂ A)) h +
        L (star c * c) h) := (mul_add _ _ _).symm
    _ = star f * L (star (a : Unitization ℂ A) * (a : Unitization ℂ A) + star c * c) h := by
      rw [← hAdd]
    _ = star f * L (algebraMap ℝ (Unitization ℂ A) (‖a‖ ^ 2)) h := by
      rw [coefficientSquareComplement_identity]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [coefficientLeftUnitization_algebraMap]
      exact mul_smul_comm _ _ _

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- Every actual C-star seminorm has the original coefficient norm bound, via its genuine completion. -/
theorem seminorm_coefficientLeft_le (p : CStarSeminorm (Carrier μ α)) (a : A) (f : Carrier μ α) :
    p (coefficientLeft μ α a f) ≤ ‖a‖ * p f := by
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra p.NonUnitalCompletion := p.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra
  let : PartialOrder p.NonUnitalCompletion := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder _
  let : StarOrderedRing p.NonUnitalCompletion := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing _
  let q : Carrier μ α →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] p.NonUnitalCompletion := p.toNonUnitalCompletion
  let F : p.NonUnitalCompletion := q f
  let X : p.NonUnitalCompletion := q (coefficientLeft μ α a f)
  let Y : p.NonUnitalCompletion :=
    q (coefficientLeftUnitization μ α (coefficientSquareComplement a) f)
  have hRaw := coefficientLeft_cross_gram_square μ α a f f
  have hSquare : star X * X + star Y * Y = ((‖a‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) • (star F * F) := by
    have h := congrArg q hRaw
    simpa only [map_add, map_mul, map_smul, map_star, F, X, Y] using h
  have hLe : star X * X ≤ ((‖a‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) • (star F * F) :=
    (le_add_of_nonneg_right (star_mul_self_nonneg Y)).trans_eq hSquare
  have hNorm := CStarAlgebra.norm_le_norm_of_le_of_nonneg hLe (star_mul_self_nonneg X)
  have hr : 0 ≤ ‖a‖ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
  have hSq : ‖X‖ ^ 2 ≤ (‖a‖ * ‖F‖) ^ 2 := by
    calc
      ‖X‖ ^ 2 = ‖star X * X‖ := by rw [CStarRing.norm_star_mul_self, pow_two]
      _ ≤ ‖((‖a‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) • (star F * F)‖ := hNorm
      _ = (‖a‖ * ‖F‖) ^ 2 := by
        rw [norm_smul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hr,
          CStarRing.norm_star_mul_self]
        ring
  have hBound : ‖X‖ ≤ ‖a‖ * ‖F‖ :=
    (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg X) (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg a) (norm_nonneg F))).mp hSq
  simpa only [X, F, q, CStarSeminorm.norm_toNonUnitalCompletion] using hBound

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- Every actual C-star seminorm has the original right coefficient bound by star exchange. -/
theorem seminorm_coefficientRight_le (p : CStarSeminorm (Carrier μ α)) (a : A) (f : Carrier μ α) :
    p (coefficientRight μ α a f) ≤ ‖a‖ * p f := by
  have hStar : star (coefficientRight μ α a f) = coefficientLeft μ α (star a) (star f) :=
    crossedStar_coefficientRight μ α a f
  calc
    p (coefficientRight μ α a f) = p (star (coefficientRight μ α a f)) := (p.map_star _).symm
    _ = p (coefficientLeft μ α (star a) (star f)) := congrArg p hStar
    _ ≤ ‖star a‖ * p (star f) := seminorm_coefficientLeft_le μ α p (star a) (star f)
    _ = ‖a‖ * p f := by rw [norm_star, p.map_star]

end OriginalGramIdentities

end

end HaarTwistedCore

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.SeminormCoefficientActions
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Extend

/-!
# Actual coefficient actions on the same-seminorm completion

Each original coefficient map is extended along the actual dense separated
completion map. The bounds are proved from the coefficient square identity,
and the extension agrees with the literal original compact-support values.
The zero seminorm and the zero coefficient algebra are included.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

namespace HaarTwistedCore

noncomputable section

universe uG uA

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

attribute [local instance] CStarSeminorm.nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra

variable (p : CStarSeminorm (Carrier μ α))

/-- The actual left coefficient map on the completion of the same original seminorm. -/
def coefficientLeftCompletion (a : A) :
    p.NonUnitalCompletion →L[ℂ] p.NonUnitalCompletion :=
  ((LinearMap.ofClass p.toNonUnitalCompletion).comp (coefficientLeft μ α a)).extendOfNorm
    (LinearMap.ofClass p.toNonUnitalCompletion)

/-- The actual right coefficient map on the completion of the same original seminorm. -/
def coefficientRightCompletion (a : A) :
    p.NonUnitalCompletion →L[ℂ] p.NonUnitalCompletion :=
  ((LinearMap.ofClass p.toNonUnitalCompletion).comp (coefficientRight μ α a)).extendOfNorm
    (LinearMap.ofClass p.toNonUnitalCompletion)

/-- Completed left multiplication has exactly the original coefficient values on the dense core. -/
theorem coefficientLeftCompletion_apply (a : A) (f : Carrier μ α) :
    coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p a (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) =
      p.toNonUnitalCompletion (coefficientLeft μ α a f) := by
  apply LinearMap.extendOfNorm_eq (p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion)
  refine ⟨‖a‖, fun h => ?_⟩
  change ‖p.toNonUnitalCompletion (coefficientLeft μ α a h)‖ ≤
    ‖a‖ * ‖p.toNonUnitalCompletion h‖
  simpa only [CStarSeminorm.norm_toNonUnitalCompletion] using seminorm_coefficientLeft_le μ α p a h

/-- Completed right multiplication has exactly the original coefficient values on the dense core. -/
theorem coefficientRightCompletion_apply (a : A) (f : Carrier μ α) :
    coefficientRightCompletion μ α p a (p.toNonUnitalCompletion f) =
      p.toNonUnitalCompletion (coefficientRight μ α a f) := by
  apply LinearMap.extendOfNorm_eq (p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion)
  refine ⟨‖a‖, fun h => ?_⟩
  change ‖p.toNonUnitalCompletion (coefficientRight μ α a h)‖ ≤
    ‖a‖ * ‖p.toNonUnitalCompletion h‖
  simpa only [CStarSeminorm.norm_toNonUnitalCompletion] using seminorm_coefficientRight_le μ α p a h

/-- The completed left action retains the actual original coefficient norm bound. -/
theorem norm_coefficientLeftCompletion_apply_le (a : A) (x : p.NonUnitalCompletion) :
    ‖coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p a x‖ ≤ ‖a‖ * ‖x‖ := by
  apply LinearMap.norm_extendOfNorm_apply_le (p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion) ‖a‖
  intro f
  change ‖p.toNonUnitalCompletion (coefficientLeft μ α a f)‖ ≤
    ‖a‖ * ‖p.toNonUnitalCompletion f‖
  simpa only [CStarSeminorm.norm_toNonUnitalCompletion] using seminorm_coefficientLeft_le μ α p a f

/-- The completed right action retains the actual original coefficient norm bound. -/
theorem norm_coefficientRightCompletion_apply_le (a : A) (x : p.NonUnitalCompletion) :
    ‖coefficientRightCompletion μ α p a x‖ ≤ ‖a‖ * ‖x‖ := by
  apply LinearMap.norm_extendOfNorm_apply_le (p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion) ‖a‖
  intro f
  change ‖p.toNonUnitalCompletion (coefficientRight μ α a f)‖ ≤
    ‖a‖ * ‖p.toNonUnitalCompletion f‖
  simpa only [CStarSeminorm.norm_toNonUnitalCompletion] using seminorm_coefficientRight_le μ α p a f

/-- The computed completed left operator has norm at most the original coefficient norm. -/
theorem norm_coefficientLeftCompletion_le (a : A) :
    ‖coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p a‖ ≤ ‖a‖ :=
  (coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p a).opNorm_le_bound (norm_nonneg a)
    (norm_coefficientLeftCompletion_apply_le μ α p a)

/-- The computed completed right operator has norm at most the original coefficient norm. -/
theorem norm_coefficientRightCompletion_le (a : A) :
    ‖coefficientRightCompletion μ α p a‖ ≤ ‖a‖ :=
  (coefficientRightCompletion μ α p a).opNorm_le_bound (norm_nonneg a)
    (norm_coefficientRightCompletion_apply_le μ α p a)

/-- Zero acts by the zero completed left operator. -/
@[simp]
theorem coefficientLeftCompletion_zero : coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p (0 : A) = 0 := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  refine congrFun ((p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion).equalizer
    (coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p 0).continuous continuous_const ?_) x
  funext f
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, coefficientLeftCompletion_apply, zero_apply]
  have h : coefficientLeft μ α (0 : A) f = 0 := by
    apply ext μ α
    intro s
    simp only [coefficientLeft_apply, zero_mul]
    rfl
  rw [h, map_zero]

/-- Zero acts by the zero completed right operator. -/
@[simp]
theorem coefficientRightCompletion_zero : coefficientRightCompletion μ α p (0 : A) = 0 := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  refine congrFun ((p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion).equalizer
    (coefficientRightCompletion μ α p 0).continuous continuous_const ?_) x
  funext f
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, coefficientRightCompletion_apply, zero_apply]
  have h : coefficientRight μ α (0 : A) f = 0 := by
    apply ext μ α
    intro s
    simp only [coefficientRight_apply, α.apply_zero, mul_zero]
    rfl
  rw [h, map_zero]

/-- Adding original coefficients adds their actual completed left operators. -/
theorem coefficientLeftCompletion_add (a b : A) :
    coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p (a + b) =
      coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p a + coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p b := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  refine congrFun ((p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion).equalizer
    (coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p (a + b)).continuous
    ((coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p a).continuous.add
      (coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p b).continuous) ?_) x
  funext f
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, Pi.add_apply,
    coefficientLeftCompletion_apply, coefficientLeft_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_add]

/-- Adding original coefficients adds their actual completed right operators. -/
theorem coefficientRightCompletion_add (a b : A) :
    coefficientRightCompletion μ α p (a + b) =
      coefficientRightCompletion μ α p a + coefficientRightCompletion μ α p b := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  refine congrFun ((p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion).equalizer
    (coefficientRightCompletion μ α p (a + b)).continuous
    ((coefficientRightCompletion μ α p a).continuous.add
      (coefficientRightCompletion μ α p b).continuous) ?_) x
  funext f
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, Pi.add_apply,
    coefficientRightCompletion_apply, coefficientRight_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_add]

/-- Scaling an original coefficient scales its actual completed left operator. -/
theorem coefficientLeftCompletion_smul (c : ℂ) (a : A) :
    coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p (c • a) = c • coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p a := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  refine congrFun ((p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion).equalizer
    (coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p (c • a)).continuous
    ((coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p a).continuous.const_smul c) ?_) x
  funext f
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, Pi.smul_apply,
    coefficientLeftCompletion_apply, coefficientLeft_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul]

/-- Scaling an original coefficient scales its actual completed right operator. -/
theorem coefficientRightCompletion_smul (c : ℂ) (a : A) :
    coefficientRightCompletion μ α p (c • a) = c • coefficientRightCompletion μ α p a := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  refine congrFun ((p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion).equalizer
    (coefficientRightCompletion μ α p (c • a)).continuous
    ((coefficientRightCompletion μ α p a).continuous.const_smul c) ?_) x
  funext f
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, Pi.smul_apply,
    coefficientRightCompletion_apply, coefficientRight_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul]

/-- Completed left coefficients compose in the original algebra order. -/
theorem coefficientLeftCompletion_mul (a b : A) :
    coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p (a * b) =
      (coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p a).comp (coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p b) := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  refine congrFun ((p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion).equalizer
    (coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p (a * b)).continuous
    ((coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p a).continuous.comp
      (coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p b).continuous) ?_) x
  funext f
  simp only [Function.comp_apply,
    coefficientLeftCompletion_apply, coefficientLeft_mul, LinearMap.comp_apply]

/-- Completed right coefficients compose in the original double-centralizer order. -/
theorem coefficientRightCompletion_mul (a b : A) :
    coefficientRightCompletion μ α p (a * b) =
      (coefficientRightCompletion μ α p b).comp (coefficientRightCompletion μ α p a) := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  refine congrFun ((p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion).equalizer
    (coefficientRightCompletion μ α p (a * b)).continuous
    ((coefficientRightCompletion μ α p b).continuous.comp
      (coefficientRightCompletion μ α p a).continuous) ?_) x
  funext f
  simp only [Function.comp_apply,
    coefficientRightCompletion_apply, coefficientRight_mul, LinearMap.comp_apply]

/-- The completed involution exchanges left coefficients with adjoint right coefficients. -/
theorem star_coefficientLeftCompletion (a : A) (x : p.NonUnitalCompletion) :
    star (coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p a x) =
      coefficientRightCompletion μ α p (star a) (star x) := by
  refine congrFun ((p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion).equalizer
    (coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p a).continuous.star
    ((coefficientRightCompletion μ α p (star a)).continuous.comp continuous_star) ?_) x
  funext f
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, coefficientLeftCompletion_apply, ← map_star,
    coefficientRightCompletion_apply]
  exact congrArg p.toNonUnitalCompletion (crossedStar_coefficientLeft μ α a f)

/-- The completed involution exchanges right coefficients with adjoint left coefficients. -/
theorem star_coefficientRightCompletion (a : A) (x : p.NonUnitalCompletion) :
    star (coefficientRightCompletion μ α p a x) =
      coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p (star a) (star x) := by
  refine congrFun ((p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion).equalizer
    (coefficientRightCompletion μ α p a).continuous.star
    ((coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p (star a)).continuous.comp continuous_star) ?_) x
  funext f
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, coefficientRightCompletion_apply, ← map_star,
    coefficientLeftCompletion_apply]
  exact congrArg p.toNonUnitalCompletion (crossedStar_coefficientRight μ α a f)

/-- The two computed completed coefficient maps are an actual compatible centralizer pair. -/
theorem coefficientCompletion_central (a : A) (x y : p.NonUnitalCompletion) :
    coefficientRightCompletion μ α p a x * y = x * coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p a y := by
  refine (p.denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion).induction_on₂
    (p := fun u v : p.NonUnitalCompletion =>
      coefficientRightCompletion μ α p a u * v = u * coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p a v)
    ?_ ?_ x y
  · exact isClosed_eq
      (((coefficientRightCompletion μ α p a).continuous.comp continuous_fst).mul continuous_snd)
      (continuous_fst.mul ((coefficientLeftCompletion μ α p a).continuous.comp continuous_snd))
  · intro f h
    rw [coefficientRightCompletion_apply, coefficientLeftCompletion_apply, ← map_mul, ← map_mul]
    exact congrArg p.toNonUnitalCompletion (convolution_coefficientLeft μ α a f h).symm
